_comment: Brief 2 Patch 2, Step 0 — pre-registered before any further benchmark run. Thresholds transcribed from the brief's own table; nothing here is tuned after seeing results.
measurement: three passes of the dev benchmark (DEV_SEED_SET), results pooled across all three passes
stage_measured: raw — the model's final submitted proposal before the balancer. No preflight loop exists yet (Brief 3, out of scope); if one is added later, the first proposal before that loop must also be reported separately.
pass_definition: PASS verdict only — a flagged row does not count as a pass. The non-fail rate (pass + flagged) is reported alongside, not in place of it.

avoidable_unserved_incidence_pct.definition: share of scenarios where rule_3 fails and the scenario is not infeasible (physics.min_achievable_unserved_mw == 0) — i.e. the shortfall was the decision's fault, not physics

safe_mode.status_this_patch: not met — safe mode is explicitly out of scope for Brief 2 Patch 2 (it belongs to Brief 3, which is on hold). Recording this honestly as unmet rather than marking it demonstrated.

unexplained_failures.definition: every failed or flagged row in the Step 6 report carries a category and a root-cause note
